title: Deactivating COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold is refused by the server
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Send a deactivate request for COD by a means other than the page (the page never offers it).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The request is refused and the app's error alert reads "Always available. COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." COD stays active.

A manual tester cannot reach this: the menu never offers Deactivate on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold. It is for an automated check.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • Story 2, Error Handling: “If a save is refused, the app's standard error alert shows the reason, using these exact texts: "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." (deactivating or deleting the default); "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." (editing or deleting a term in use); "Always available. COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated."; "Pick an active term other than Credit Hold." (making an inactive term or Credit Hold the default); "Credit term not found." (the term was deleted meanwhile). The delete confirmation stays open when the delete is refused.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Deactivate of COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold refused (server) | "Always available. COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." | Standard error alert”
  • Key Decisions: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can never be deactivated.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "1 List and row menus", "3 New credit term and Inactive tab", "4 Everything deactivated and an empty tab" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the page never offers Deactivate on these three terms, so only a request sent outside the page can reach this refusal
